entry.title: Camacho Lab Takes First Place at COS’s Halloween Spooktacular

link.title: Camacho Lab Takes First Place at COS’s Halloween Spooktacular

entry.content: The Camacho Lab proudly earned 1st Place in the 2026 College of Science’s Halloween Spooktacular costume competition with our Ghostbusters group costume! This marks the third year the lab has taken home the top prize, reflecting not only our enthusiasm for campus events but also the teamwork and camaraderie that define our research group. The competition highlighted the creativity and collaborative spirit of the College of Sciences community, and we were honored to represent the Department of Neurosciences, Developmental and Regenerative Biology. Special thanks to all lab members who contributed their time, energy, and ideas to make this year’s entry a success!
entry.summary: Ready to bust retinal mysteries and paranormal activity alike.

entry.title: Celebrating Dr. Camacho’s Birthday!
entry.content: This week, the lab came together to celebrate Dr. Erika Camacho’s birthday and to recognize her leadership, mentorship, and dedication to advancing vision science research. We are grateful for everything Dr. Camacho does for our team and the broader scientific community. On behalf of all lab members, we wish her a wonderful birthday and a year filled with happiness, success, and exciting new discoveries. Thank you for your leadership, encouragement, and dedication to science and training the next generation of researchers!

entry.title: Addison Receives Her White Coat!
entry.content:
The Camacho Lab is proud to celebrate Addison Kanke on receiving her white coat, a milestone that recognizes her commitment to scientific research, scholarship, and professional growth. Throughout her time in the Camacho Lab, Addison has demonstrated curiosity, dedication, and a strong commitment to scientific discovery. We are excited to see her take this next step and know she will continue to make a positive impact in research.

Congratulations, Addison, on this well-deserved achievement. We are proud of you and look forward to following your continued success!
